company.shortDescription: Insempra is a biotechnology-powered company enabling businesses to transform their ingredient lists with superior bio-based products.
company.description:
Insempra is a biotechnology-powered company enabling businesses to transform their ingredient lists with superior products made in collaboration with nature.
For too long, businesses have relied on petrochemical production and environmental exploitation, depleting our limited natural resources and polluting our planet.
Environmental issues, consumer demand, and regulatory restrictions are changing the ingredients landscape dramatically. The beauty & personal care, food & nutrition and fashion industries are under immense pressure to shift to sustainable alternatives.
Insempra’s advanced technology platform enables the production of superior natural ingredients at industrial scale to help the world’s leading brands to transform their products.
Together it is our mission to grow a better future.

aiResearchSummary.text: Insempra is engaged in developing microbial methods for conversion of lignocellulosic hydrolysates using oleaginous yeast, as described in 'Microbial methods for conversion of lignocellulosic hydrolysates.' The abstract details processes for microbial fatty acid, lipid, and oil production from lignocellulosic biomass, focusing on transforming lignocellulose degradation products into bio-based ingredients. These activities highlight research in sustainable biotechnological ingredient production.
